Title: The Battle
Content: The conditions did seem just right
So I was ready to go in
When Coach called out my name.
But just before I took my shot,
It caught the ball, which flew too high,
Though I had struck it low.
I kicked it well, but we still lost,
And I relished in the snow,
We tugged our sleds up Prospect Peak,
Blinded by the squall, I crashed.
While Jake shot by me, laughing,
“Change the way you think of things,”
“Try to make the wind your friend;
Things may not seem so bad.”
So flying kites in a spring contest,
To lift my entry so high that it
Left Jake’s kite in the dust.
Now that I’ve come to value
I’ve made a blowing, breezy friend
